content.title: Report: Truth behind Rory McIlroy and Erica Stoll's divorce drama revealed
content.text: Rob Gronkowski has offered up some dating advice to his former teammate Tom Brady as the single NFL legend continues to play the field.The seven-time Super Bowl winner has been on the market since his divorce from Brazilian supermodel Gisele Bundchen in October 2022. Brady, 48, has sparked romance rumors with a number of high-profile names, including model Irina Shayk, actress Sofia Vergara and, most recently, social media sensation Alix Earle. However, the retired signal caller does not appear to have settled down despite the buzz surrounding his dating life. 'Just follow your heart, Tom,' Gronkowski told Page Six, weighing in on his former teammate's love life.He added: 'You know, wherever your heart is leading you, wherever your gut instinct is leading you. Just follow that heart, Tom.'Brady's legendary success on the field is well-documented and Gronkowski believes the former quarterback should channel his passing prowess when it comes to dating.'Just like he has with the game of football, treat the game of football… like how you treat dating and you'll be very successful. Like, a number one of all time,' the former tight end said.When asked to choose out of the trio of Brady, Julian Edelman or Mike Vrabel, Gronkowski immediately responded with Brady, admitting it was a 'surprise answer.' 'But Tom is on a hot streak right now,' Gronkowski said. 'He's ready to go.'He admitted that back in the day Edelman 'was my go-to guy' and his 'wingman,' but claimed that the former wide receiver has toned down his partying his recent years. Gronkowski's dating advice comes after Brady, who was married to Bundchen for 13 years, was first seen enjoying a flirtatious New Year's Eve with TikTok star Earle in St. Barths.Brady was later filmed groping the online personality at a party before last month's Super Bowl in Santa Clara, California.However, a source suggested to the Daily Mail last month that the retired signal caller's fling with the social media sensation also wasn't serious.The insider claimed that the father-of-three wasn't looking to settle down anytime soon.'Tom isn't dating anyone specifically,' they revealed. 'He's not really looking for that. Dating isn't something ever on his mind.'He's kind of awkward when it comes to dating. Surprisingly, he doesn't really have great game. Usually it's a woman making the first move with him, which would surprise a lot of people. He lets them take the lead a lot of the time.'Tom and Alix are not exclusively dating. It's a hooking up and having fun type of thing, at least for now, but she is totally his type.'Earle is only recently single after breaking up with NFL wide receiver Braxton Berrios after two years.Remarkably, Berrios is a former teammate of Brady's, having been drafted by the Patriots in 2018 when Brady was the team's starting quarterback.Read more Single Tom Brady is on a hot streak, reveals Rob Gronkowski Single Tom Brady is on a hot streak, reveals Rob Gronkowski, after Alix Earle links The former quarterback set tongues wagging when he was spotted with Alix Earle Brady sparked romance rumors over New Year's Eve when he was spotted cozying up to Earle Brady sparked romance rumors over New Year's Eve when he was spotted cozying up to Earle The social media influencer is only recently single herself after splitting from Braxton Berrios ; ; ;
